groundContact.snifferNeutralLight: Foreclaw (1098, 838) at alpha ≥32 is the generated candidate support point; the tongue reaches visible bottom 848. The existing anchor is retained; the technical contract separately limits paw error to 1 world pixel and tongue extension to 2 world pixels.
groundContact.sourceMeaning: This contact measurement concerns the generated candidate, not an original game frame.

limits: Four one-frame static poses; no new animation or exact original timing is certified.
Native canvas captures do not establish Chromium, browser UI, HTTP, service worker or offline behavior.
The engine mirrors the same candidate for the opposite facing; no independent source view was newly inspected.
No generated base, portrait or asset is newly certified fidelity 1:1.
The eight selected states do not certify all collisions, guards, damage outcomes or finishers.
